title: Tree Node
goal: Classify each tree record as Root Inner or Leaf.
strategy: A null parent identifies the root before any other rule. Nonroot nodes appearing as another record parent are inner nodes; the remaining nodes are leaves.

phasePurposes.start: Classify each tree record as Root Inner or Leaf.
phasePurposes.inspect: A null parent identifies the root before any other rule. Nonroot nodes appearing as another record parent are inner nodes; the remaining nodes are leaves.
phasePurposes.update: A null parent identifies the root before any other rule. Nonroot nodes appearing as another record parent are inner nodes; the remaining nodes are leaves.
phasePurposes.done: Classify each tree record as Root Inner or Leaf.

edgeCases: A singleton is Root even though it has no children
A long chain has one root one leaf and inner links
Input row order does not determine the root
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
